entities.name: Jardín Etnobotánico de Oaxaca
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Jardín Etnobotánico de Oaxaca is a botanical garden in Oaxaca City, Mexico. It occupies 2.32 acres of land adjacent to the Church of Santo Domingo. It is administered by the state government of Oaxaca.
